mode: interactive TUI, --permission-mode default, isolated config, loopback fixture model returning one AskUserQuestion tool_use
note: Field names and relative timing are actual (offset 0 = PreToolUse). Session IDs, paths, prompts and tool payloads are omitted; tool_use_id is the fixture model's synthetic value. The probe did not answer the dialog; its window was visible on the interactive desktop and PostToolUse arrived about 16.5 s after the start, so the source of that response (a person at the desktop) cannot be excluded and is not attributed.
findings: In permission_mode default the sequence and field names are identical to the auto-mode capture: PreToolUse(tool_use_id) -> PermissionRequest(AskUserQuestion, no tool_use_id, same tool_input and prompt_id) -> permission_prompt Notification about 6.2 s later (prompt_id, no tool fields) -> PostToolUse(original tool_use_id) -> Stop.
The only observed difference is the permission_mode value reported on hooks that carry it (default instead of auto); the Notification carries no permission_mode.
The question dialog's PermissionRequest and permission_prompt are therefore not specific to auto mode.
unverified: whether the permission_prompt still fires when the dialog is answered within the provider delay
